user_intent: Multi-chain treasury infrastructure visualized as Renaissance-era water management and aqueduct system technical illustration

subject.description: Four parallel aqueduct channels at different elevations, each carrying water (representing different blockchain networks) with distinct architectural styles, all converging into a central cistern
Grand central treasury chamber shown in architectural cross-section, with water from all aqueducts collecting into unified reservoir with measurement gauges
Intricate sluice gates, water wheels, and flow control mechanisms managing the convergence of different water sources, rendered with mechanical detail

scene.location: Warm sepia-toned aged parchment with subtle water stains appropriate to hydraulic engineering documents
background_elements: elevation markings and water level indicators
flow direction arrows in classical style

video_prompt.narrative_concept: Water from multiple mountain sources at different elevations flows through an engineered aqueduct system into a unified measuring cistern

scenes.description: Wide view of four stone aqueduct channels descending from different mountain elevations, each carrying water at different flow rates and colors (representing different chains)
scenes.motion: Water flows continuously in each channel, camera pans across the sources
scenes.focal_point: The diversity of sources at varying heights

scenes.description: The aqueducts converge through a series of flow control gates and measurement wheels, water mixing and normalizing as channels merge through engineering structures
scenes.motion: Water wheels turn from flow, gates adjust levels, streams combine smoothly
scenes.focal_point: The convergence engineering and flow regulation

scenes.description: The unified stream pours into a central stone cistern with measurement markings, a brass gauge shows the total volume, water surface settles to calm
scenes.motion: Final pour into cistern, ripples settle, gauge needle steadies
scenes.focal_point: The measurement gauge showing unified total

environment.setting: Roman-style engineering complex in mountainous terrain
environment.lighting: Late afternoon sun, warm directional light casting long shadows
environment.atmosphere: Mist from water, distant mountains, ancient stonework

style.medium: Architectural engineering drawing brought to life
style.color_palette: Stone grey, water blue-green, brass measurement instruments, terracotta accents
style.texture: Weathered stone, flowing water caustics, aged brass

motion_language.camera_movement: Aerial establishing shot, then follows water flow downstream
motion_language.subject_animation: Continuous water flow, turning water wheels, settling cistern
motion_language.transition_style: Following shot tracking the water's journey
